definitions.name: missing, invalid or contradictory usage never becomes a guessed estimate
malformed telemetry never throws, and clearing removes totals and request history
pricing facts are immutable, dated and attached to each estimate

semantics: Original callbacks, source helpers, all18 usage values and all12 original assertion expressions execute unchanged.
Own undefined, nonfinite Number values and accessor descriptors are tagged, never converted to null or invoked by capture.
The source getter actually runs inside original update and is caught by the source tracker; no native getter-equivalence claim is made.
Actual frozen pricing facts before/after both throwing mutation attempts and all nested frozen objects are recorded; no current-provider pricing claim.
